peacp.source: Observed PV Code-session runtime + existing worker-bootstrap Native notification drain protocol
peacp.fallback_trigger: scheduled same-session check only when the persistent session supports it
peacp.rule: PR activity is transport. The persistent Code session drains its native notification inbox, resolves the bound PR timeline and current authority/exact SHA, executes the newest valid in-lane work, posts evidence, then remains armed.

C.wake_proof_interpretation: PR activity reached the existing persistent Code session and was drained from its native notifications; proof does not require a separately exposed subscribe_pr_activity API.
